description: Repo-scale (c-jobqueue): add an atomic all-or-nothing bulk job-completion function
prompts: Add `int scheduler_complete_bulk(Scheduler *s, const int *ids, int count)` to scheduler.h/scheduler.c. It must validate the WHOLE batch before completing anything: return 0 (changing NOTHING) if `count` isn't positive, or if ANY id in `ids` does not currently reference a RUNNING job - even one bad id anywhere in the batch must leave every job's state completely untouched, not just the ones after the bad id. Only once every id is confirmed running should the whole batch actually be completed (reusing the existing scheduler_complete logic). Returns 1 on success.
name: add_c_jobqueue_bulk_complete_atomic
